RULE-1.gloss: Total revenue is 40 when there are candles sold and a price per candle
RULE-1.verify_reason: not a universal revenue formula; it fixes revenue to 40 regardless of quantity/price.

RULE-2.gloss: Gross profit is 30 from revenue and costs
RULE-2.verify_reason: encodes a fixed value 30 instead of a general relation grossProfit = revenue − costs.

RULE-3.verify_reason: net profit generally equals gross profit minus other expenses; not always equal.

INF-1.gloss: RevenueValue(n_40) derived from FACT-1, FACT-2 via RULE-1 using Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: GrossProfitValue(n_30) derived from INF-1 and FACT-3 via RULE-2 using Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: NetProfitValue(n_30) derived from INF-2 via RULE-3 using Modus Ponens
